name: gh-secrets-e2e
//: The offline end-to-end suite: spawns the compiled gh-secrets binary against wiremock, tempdirs and a stand-in bw. No Cargo edge to gh-secrets (it never links the library), so the implicit dependency is what puts it behind every crate change.

test.//: dependsOn gh-secrets:build so a broken binary build fails here, named, before any journey runs. Under coverage the journeys then drive the instrumented copy scripts/coverage.sh builds into target/llvm-cov-target, so their lines count toward workspace:coverage; on Windows they drive gh-secrets:build's binary directly.
